_comment: Attended_Games__dlm DMO — captured verbatim from devorg (d360_dmo_get 2026-09-03). The ONE data object the Keeping_Score SDM references as a Dmo (the other six ride their DLOs directly). It stays a DMO because its SDM measures use title-cased field names — [Attended_Games].[Wax_Game_ID], [Venue], [Game_Date] — which DMOs produce and DLOs (source-cased) do not. 'name' omits the __dlm suffix (the API appends it). System fields (DataSource__c, DataSourceObject__c, InternalOrganization__c, KQ_*) are auto-added by the platform. dataType/label/PK match devorg exactly.

description: Games George personally attended — the 178-game spine. One row per attended game: date, both teams (name + Retrosheet code), venue, location, and game type. Source: BigQuery wax_baseball.attended_games via the Attended Games data stream.
